runs.text: A few simple ideas sit underneath everything else in this book.

heading_path: Welcome and Introduction to Customer Care

blocks.text: A few simple ideas sit underneath everything else in this book.

runs.text: 1. Every guest gives you a moment of truth.

A moment of truth is any small point of contact where a guest decides how they feel about you and the hotel. A greeting at the door, a phone answered on the second ring, a quick reply to a message. These moments are small, but they are exactly where trust is won or lost. Your English is the tool that helps you win them.

runs.text: 2. You have two kinds of customers.

External customers are the guests who pay to stay. Internal customers are your own colleagues, such as housekeeping, the kitchen, or the manager you hand a request to. The warmth you show your colleagues usually flows straight through to the guest. Great service is a team habit before it is a guest habit.
